name: Small Portacabin
description:
Small Portacabin — Right-Sized for Small Teams and Tight Sites

A small portacabin from SAMAN is the correct sizing for a supervisor, a one-to-four-person project office, or a compact deployment that genuinely needs a small footprint, not a large one — starting at 10×10 ft. It is not a stripped or undersized cabin: it uses the same welded IS 2062 mild-steel frame and finished interior as our larger units, matched to a small requirement.

When Small Is the Right Size — a Fit, Not a Fallback

Five deployments where a small portacabin is the correct and complete answer. A single supervisor's site cabin — one desk, one chair, personal use through a shift: a 10×10 ft is exactly right, and a 20×10 is floor you would pay for without using. A two-person team with no meeting requirement — two parallel workstations: the 20×8 ft slim office seats both comfortably where site depth is tight. An SME's additional workspace — one or two back-office staff on a plot where a brick extension is not viable: a finished cabin is working in 7–21 days, before an extension would have foundations. A storage-with-access unit — one person enters, retrieves, logs and leaves: a lockable 10×10 with a light and a socket serves this exactly. A storekeeper cabin beside the material yard — register shelf, document table, one occupant: 100 sq ft is the right allocation, and more would waste plot and budget. In each case the cabin matches the requirement precisely — small because small is correct, never because it is all that was available.

10×10, 20×8 or 20×10 — the One Decision to Make

10×10 ft is right for one to two occupants with a desk each and no visitor seating — solo supervision, monitoring, storekeeping. Its working limit is two adjacent desks. 20×8 ft is right when two or three people work simultaneously and the site offers length, not depth — a slim office that fits where standard cabins cannot. 20×10 ft is right when a visitor chair, a drawing table, or a third and fourth workstation enters the requirement — the step where a small office becomes a small TEAM office. Decision rule: one person and a window — 10×10. Two working in parallel on a narrow site — 20×8. Anyone receiving visitors, or a team of three to four — 20×10. Larger sizes in the ladder carry the same right-sizing logic upward.

What Is Standard in a Small Portacabin

Every SAMAN small portacabin ships factory-finished from our Bengaluru and Greater Noida units: insulated walls and roof, pre-laminated interior, vinyl floor, aluminium sliding windows with grills on the long faces, a lockable MS entry door, LED lighting, socket points on a distribution board, and AC provision — proportioned to the size you choose. Not factory-fitted in any configuration: loose furniture, the AC unit itself, and internal partitions — confirmed at order so you pay for exactly your requirement. The structure is the same welded IS 2062 mild-steel frame as every larger SAMAN cabin: a sizing choice, never a specification cut.

Small Office or Smallest Cabin — Choosing the Right Page

If your need is a working office at compact scale, you are on the right page. If it is the smallest possible post — a guard point, ticket window or gate booth — the mini porta cabin is the range built around that job, and comparing the two takes one minute. For a fitted multi-desk interior see the porta cabin office; to compare all porta cabin sizes and types, the hub carries the complete ladder. Delivered and installed across South and North India in 7–21 working days; transport quoted by distance at order.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a small portacabin best for?

Supervisor cabins, one-to-four-person project offices and compact site-management units — a proper finished office at a small footprint.

What does a small portacabin cost?

From ₹1,36,000 (10×10) ex-GST, HSN 9406, 18% GST extra — same build as larger cabins, sized to a small requirement.

Small portacabin vs mini porta cabin?

A mini cabin is the smallest guard-post/kiosk footprint; a small portacabin is a compact OFFICE for a small team. Pick by whether you need a post or a workspace.

Is a small portacabin lower quality because it's small?

No — same IS 2062 frame, insulation and finish as larger cabins; it's a sizing choice, not a spec cut.

Sizes and delivery?

Compact sizes from 10×10 ft; delivered across South & North India in 7–21 working days.
